# ColleagueAI

Full machine-readable catalogue: https://www.colleagueai.ai/llms-full.txt

ColleagueAI is building a planned portfolio of governed AI agents and AI controls for enterprise operations, finance, risk, compliance, legal, procurement, HR, sales, and service workflows. No agent is commercially available yet: every agent in the catalogue is shown as "Coming soon", and interest can be registered per agent.

## What ColleagueAI offers

ColleagueAI provides governed AI agent packages with governance, auditability, access control, risk scoring, and deployment controls. Customers deploy and run the agents in their own Microsoft environment; ColleagueAI does not provide customer implementation services.

The agent catalogue includes use cases across:
- Operations
- Risk and compliance
- Finance
- Legal and procurement
- HR and people operations
- Sales and marketing
- Data quality and reporting
- Service management

## Continuous Certification (Coming soon)

One licence. Continuous assurance. Buy once. Govern continuously.

Agent licences are perpetual. Continuous Certification is a planned subscription (L2, L3 and L4; L5 is not offered) that keeps a purchased Colleague AI Certified Release current as rules, risks and the Microsoft platform change: published change assessments for the covered scope, an updated certified release at no further licence fee when a covered change requires one, and online certificate verification. Security fixes during the support period go to every licensee, subscribed or not. Planned additions: quarterly assurance report and AI Token Economy consumption benchmark. It is Colleague AI's own programme, not third-party accreditation or a compliance opinion. Subscriptions are not yet open. Full details, with what is built, what is a subscription benefit and what is planned: https://www.colleagueai.ai/certified and https://www.colleagueai.ai/llms-full.txt

## Trust and deployment model

Production deployments are designed for enterprise governance, controlled access, audit trail, and customer-environment alignment.

This website has two forms, both at /demo: the demo request and, for Coming-soon agents, the per-agent interest registration (work email, company, intended use, Microsoft environment and timeframe). The demo / access request at /demo which submits your enquiry details (work email, company, role and preferred date) to ColleagueAI so we can arrange a demo. All other enquiries reach ColleagueAI by email.
